name: ah-issue-to-draft-pr
description: Linear issue to draft pull request. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

steps.prompt: For repository {{repository}} and Linear issue {{issue}} (task: {{task}}): read the repository AGENTS.md, read the issue, confirm no other session has claimed it, and produce acceptance criteria, scope and the focused checks. Work only in a worktree under C:\wt. Do not edit files. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

Claim the issue (agent:kiro, In Progress). Implement the smallest change meeting this plan: {{previous.output}}. Add or update tests, run the focused checks, commit to a feature branch, push it and open a DRAFT pull request against the integration branch. Report branch, head SHA, commands and pass/fail counts. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

Given this handoff: {{previous.output}}. If the tests passed, run gh pr ready so the review starts; if not, leave the pull request a draft and report why. Do not wait or poll. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.

Independently review the head commit named in {{previous.output}}. Read-only: do not edit, commit or merge. Return Pass, Fail or Blocked with file and line findings. Only run this step if the pull request is ready for review, not a draft. Limits: at most three remediation iterations, then stop and report BLOCKED. Never merge, release or deploy. No expensive review while the pull request is a draft. A new head commit invalidates any earlier PASS. The reviewer is never the agent that wrote the change.
